dialogue.text: Welcome to Macau, Martin! Welcome to UNU-IIST.
Here we turn requirements into prototypes automatically. Mostly automatically.
Careful out there. The bugs in Macau gamble with your memory.
Told you Joogie was a good name. It got into CAV!
Next up: infeasible code detection at scale. Also, the egg tarts here are dangerous.
Hi, I'm Willem. I once wrote a model checker called Java PathFinder.
Your infeasible-code work is interesting. Maybe we work together some day.
Some day may take a while. Keep walking.
Error invariants got into FM! Now let's make fault localization flow-sensitive.
I'll handle the interpolants. You handle the jet lag.
